Two glass plates are held a constant distance apart, forming a growing sheet of laminated glass resin. As rollers pull the plates apart, the length is increasing by $2\,\text{cm}\text{/min},$ while the $1\,\text{cm}$ thickness does not change. If resin is injected so that the volume of the sheet is increasing at a rate of $32\,{\text{cm}}^{3}\text{/min},$  how fast is its width changing when its dimensions are $10\,\text{cm}$ in length and $4\,\text{cm}$ in width?

current_example.problem:
A cube is shrinking uniformly at a rate of $3\,\text{mm}^3/\text{s}.$ How fast is each side of the cube shrinking when the volume of the cube is $27\,\text{mm}^3?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14211452/assets/0ca7021995b1a501f6cb862b33649bdb1927f7ce4a8630a9e261382a193f40a4.png)
current_example.worked_solution:
Let $x$ be the side of the cube and $V$ be its volume. We are given that 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}V}{\text{d}t}=-3\,{\text{mm}}^{3}/\text{s}.\end{aligned}
$$

We would like to find $\dfrac{\textrm d x}{\textrm dt}$ when $V=27\,\text{mm}^3.$

We start with the formula for the volume of the cube:

$$
V=x^3
$$

Now, we differentiate with respect to time using the chain rule, and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}V & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({x}^{3}) \\ \frac{\text{d}V}{\text{d}t} & =3{x}^{2}\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}.\end{aligned}
$$

Before we plug in the known values, we need to find the value of $x$ when $V = 27\,\text{mm}^3.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}V & ={x}^{3} \\ 27 & ={x}^{3} \\ x & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

We can now plug $x=3$ and $\dfrac{\textrm d V}{\textrm dt}=-3$ into the expression for $\dfrac{\textrm d x}{\textrm dt}.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}V}{\text{d}t} & =3{x}^{2}\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t} \\ -3 & =3(3)^{2}\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t}\, \\ \frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t} & =-\frac{1}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the sides of the cube are shrinking at a rate of $\dfrac{1}{9}\,\text{mm}/\text{s}$ at the moment when $x=3\,\textrm{mm}.$
